what: An analyst who sets Summary to This month (or to custom dates), opens a trial from it and clicks "‹ Back to <watchlist>" lands on Summary showing This week, so the period they were reading is lost and they have to choose it again. Before this build the same link went back to the period they left; the browser's Back button still does. The cause is that the trial page now builds the link from the watchlist and tab in the trial's address, and the address does not carry Summary's period (the spec leaves the period out of the trial address, but did not ask for the link to stop keeping it within one visit).

After an analyst removes a trial from the watchlist they opened it from (Remove from this list on the trial page) and then switches to the trial's History or Trial details tab, "‹ Back to" names the trial's other watchlist instead, and the address changes to name that one. The spec says the link keeps naming the watchlist the analyst came from until a later reload, so they can keep working through its queue. I am not sure this counts as a defect: it behaved the same before this build, and the spec only says the removal behaviour is unchanged. The cause is that switching a tab redraws the trial page from its address, which falls back to the first watchlist exactly as a reload does.
